record.field: Decides whether an agent's fix is merged, or applied to production before it is merged. Reads the incident and its pull request to decide.
Privilege: an agent run's end moves the incident it works for

Taken whenever a run working for an incident ends, by whoever ends it (the runner's service user, the lease reaper, an administrator): a diagnosis or a fix that ends records its verdict on the incident, hands a real defect to a fix run, and a hotfix or a production revision resolves the incidents it ships. Every write is logged.
